messages.subject: Modelling hierarchical data in INLA
parts:
Hello INLA users,
I am still learning how to use INLA. I want to model hierarchical dataset with binary outcome (perinatal mortality) with household and clusters being the source of random effect. However, I want to use prior knowledge I have that perinatal mortality is 41.6 deaths per 1000 live births. I also want to use conjugate beta hyper prior. I want to include 41.6 as hyper prior in my model but the problem I have is how do I insert it in the model.
I am completely unaware what to do.
Your assistance will be highly appreciated
